description: This file defines an abstract class `AbstractThingAdapter` which serves as a base for adapter classes that handle thing commands within the Eclipse Ditto protocol adapter framework. It includes static pattern mappings for different thing-related paths and a constructor that initializes the class with mapping strategies and a header translator.

classes.name: AbstractThingAdapter
classes.description: An abstract class for adapters that handle Eclipse Ditto thing commands, providing path pattern mappings and initialization logic.

methods.name: AbstractThingAdapter
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the adapter with provided mapping strategies and header translator, setting up path pattern matching.
